    appliesTo:

    assert:

  - id: expected-value-kind
    appliesTo:

      or:
        - and:
            - eq:
                - field: expectedKind
                - literal: text
            - isVariant:

        - and:

        - and:
            - eq:

                - literal: reference
            - isVariant:
                value:
                  field: value
                variant: reference
    diagnostic:
      code: fill-value.type-mismatch
      severity: warning
      at:
        field: value
      message: Значение заполнения не соответствует типу стандартного реквизита
  - id: owner-reference
    appliesTo:
      - xml-import

    when:
      and:
        - eq:
            - field: policy
            - literal: ownerReference
        - isVariant:
            value:
              field: value
            variant: reference
    assert:
      or:
        - and:
            - exists:
                in:
                  input: owners
                as: owner
                where:
                  literal: true
            - not:
                one:
                  in:
                    input: owners
                  as: owner
                  where:
                    literal: true
            - eq:
                - variantText:
                    value:
                      field: value
                    variant: reference
                - literal: .
        - exists:

                    value:
                      field: value
                    variant: reference

                  var: owner

      code: fill-value.type-mismatch

      at:

        - not:
            eq:

      at:

  - id: fixed-text-length

      - yaml-validation
    when:
      and:
        - eq:
            - field: expectedKind
            - literal: text
        - isVariant:
            value:
              field: value
            variant: text
        - matches:
            value:

            pattern: '[1-9][0-9]*'
        - eq:
            - field: allowedTextLength
            - literal: Fixed
    assert:
      textLengthEquals:

            value:
              field: value
            variant: text
        limit:

    diagnostic:
